title: Effects of Circadian Rhythm on Glycemic Regulation During Continuous Moderate Exercise and Intense Intermittent Disease in Adolescents Living With Type 1 Diabetes
official: Effets du Rythme Circadien Sur la régulation glycémique Lors d'Exercices modérés Continus et Intermittents Intenses Chez Des Adolescents Vivant Avec le diabète de Type 1
summary: Interventional research with minimal risks and constraints on the effects of circadian rhythm on glycemic regulation during intense moderate, continuous and intermittent exercise in adolescents living with type 1 diabetes
